about: Blind-routing answer key. Feed only text to a router. expect is primary; alt preserves justified overlaps. external qualifies expect with a sibling plugin. routes are exhaustive permitted ordered skill loads (one or two skills); any extra or unrelated Phaser activation fails. routeJustifications explain overlap and requiredReference conditions: a task-reference handoff passes only when that public reference is loaded before implementation. Direct core-to-domain routes are bounded to two skills. Every external near miss forbids all local Phaser skills, regardless of nearMissFor. Technology prompts intentionally name APIs; task-language prompts are uncued requirements; policy-cued-task is reported separately. Outcome-language prompts are requests typed mid-session that name only the result wanted, never Phaser or an API: give the router their context line with the text and score them as their own group. needsBoth names the skills a complete answer loads; a router that loads only one of them is half right. Static tests validate key integrity, not live selection or usefulness.
